units.source_text: 看我當時和家人的合照就會發現，其他人都是一臉正經，唯獨我莫名其妙地笑歪了臉。

en.t: If you look at photographs of me with my family from that time, you will see that everyone else has a solemn face, while I alone am smiling with my face oddly twisted.

units.source_text: 這也是我既幼稚又可悲的一種搞笑方式。

en.t: This too was a childish and pathetic kind of clowning on my part.

units.source_text: 而且，無論家人對我說什麼，我從不頂嘴。

en.t: And no matter what my family said to me, I never talked back.

units.source_text: 他們寥寥數語的責備，都會讓我感覺如晴天霹靂一樣強烈，使我幾近發瘋，別說是頂嘴。

en.t: Even their briefest scoldings struck me as violently as a bolt from the blue and nearly drove me mad, so talking back was out of the question.

units.source_text: 我甚至覺得他們的責備一定是人類千古不變的「真理」，

en.t: I even felt that their reproaches must be the eternal and unchanging truth of humankind.

units.source_text: 我缺乏去實踐這種「真理」的能力，因而無法與人類相處。

en.t: Since I lacked the ability to put that truth into practice, I could not get along with human beings.

units.source_text: 所以，我既無力反駁，也無法為自己辯解。

en.t: So I had neither the strength to argue back nor the ability to defend myself.
